## [1.8.0](https://github.com/benzophury/oraimo-health-morphe-patches/compare/v1.7.0...v1.8.0) (2026-08-31)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **ci:** add CI markers to README for automated Morphe release generation ([67439af](https://github.com/benzophury/oraimo-health-morphe-patches/commit/67439afb1bc2d2be8c58df9595ec456616efce2e))

### ✨ New Features

* **core:** introduce modular v2.3 patches with DNS hardcoding, offline network mode, and layout pruning ([5473a7c](https://github.com/benzophury/oraimo-health-morphe-patches/commit/5473a7c3668d355885b3a5e2b314315455ad8159))
* **debloat:** add manifest debloat patch to prune telemetry services and cloud activities ([87628fb](https://github.com/benzophury/oraimo-health-morphe-patches/commit/87628fb73a93b540e1ebc66626687c64151b57a6))

patches.name: Air-Gap Manifest
patches.description: Strips INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, and Wi-Fi permissions from AndroidManifest.xml for sandbox isolation.

patches.name: DNS Hardcoding
patches.description: Hardcodes DNS lookup in OkHttp to fail locally with UnknownHostException, preventing any remote DNS or HTTP traffic.

patches.name: Hide Navigation Tabs (Layout)
patches.description: Statically collapses Mall, Sport, and Mine tabs to 0dp in activity_main.xml, keeping Data and Device tabs.

patches.name: Manifest Debloat
patches.description: Prunes background telemetry upload services, aggressive keepalive daemons, and cloud activities from AndroidManifest.xml.

patches.name: Offline Network Mode
patches.description: Forces NetworkUtil.isConnected() to return false, making the app believe the phone has no internet.
